requirements.title: logged-in user sees the product inventory
preconditions: Standard user credentials are available via CI secret / .env
The SauceDemo instance is reachable at https://www.saucedemo.com
An active authenticated session exists via storageState
acceptanceCriteria: Given the inventory page is loaded at /inventory.html
When the authenticated user lands on the page
Then the page heading displays 'Products'
And exactly 6 product items are visible
requirements.expectedOutcome: Inventory page loads with 6 product items and a 'Products' heading and no console errors

requirements.title: user can sort products A to Z
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
The inventory page is loaded with all 6 products visible
acceptanceCriteria: Given the inventory page is displayed
When the user selects 'Name (A to Z)' from the sort dropdown
Then the product names are displayed in ascending alphabetical order
requirements.expectedOutcome: Product list reorders to match ascending alphabetical sort with no page reload errors

requirements.title: user can sort products Z to A
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
The inventory page is loaded with all 6 products visible
acceptanceCriteria: Given the inventory page is displayed
When the user selects 'Name (Z to A)' from the sort dropdown
Then the product names are displayed in descending alphabetical order
requirements.expectedOutcome: Product list reorders to match descending alphabetical sort with no page reload errors

requirements.title: user can sort products by price low to high
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
The inventory page is loaded with all 6 products visible
acceptanceCriteria: Given the inventory page is displayed
When the user selects 'Price (low to high)' from the sort dropdown
Then the products are ordered from the lowest price to the highest price
requirements.expectedOutcome: Product list reorders by ascending price with no page reload errors

requirements.title: user can sort products by price high to low
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
The inventory page is loaded with all 6 products visible
acceptanceCriteria: Given the inventory page is displayed
When the user selects 'Price (high to low)' from the sort dropdown
Then the products are ordered from the highest price to the lowest price
requirements.expectedOutcome: Product list reorders by descending price with no page reload errors

requirements.title: adding one item increments the cart badge to 1
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
The inventory page is loaded
The cart is empty (badge is not visible)
acceptanceCriteria: Given the inventory page is displayed with an empty cart
When the user clicks 'Add to cart' on the first product
Then the cart badge in the top navigation displays '1'
requirements.expectedOutcome: Cart badge appears and shows the value 1 after one item is added

requirements.title: adding two items increments the cart badge to 2
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
The inventory page is loaded
The cart is empty (badge is not visible)
acceptanceCriteria: Given the inventory page is displayed with an empty cart
When the user clicks 'Add to cart' on the first product
And the user clicks 'Add to cart' on the second product
Then the cart badge in the top navigation displays '2'
requirements.expectedOutcome: Cart badge shows the value 2 after two distinct items are added

requirements.title: added item appears on the cart page
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
The inventory page is loaded
The cart is empty
acceptanceCriteria: Given the inventory page is displayed
When the user adds the first product to the cart
And navigates to the cart page
Then exactly 1 item is listed in the cart
And the cart item name matches the product name from the inventory
requirements.expectedOutcome: Cart page shows the correct product that was added from the inventory

requirements.title: removing an item from cart clears it and removes the badge
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
One item has been added to the cart
The cart page is displayed
acceptanceCriteria: Given the cart page shows 1 item and the badge displays '1'
When the user clicks 'Remove' on the item
Then the cart shows 0 items
And the cart badge is no longer visible in the top navigation
requirements.expectedOutcome: Cart is emptied and badge disappears after the only item is removed

requirements.title: completing checkout with 2 products shows correct price breakdown and order confirmation
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
Two items have been added to the cart
The cart page is accessible
acceptanceCriteria: Given the cart contains 2 items
When the user proceeds to checkout and fills in valid shipping information
Then the order review shows a tax value greater than zero
And the displayed total equals item total plus tax
And after finishing, the confirmation heading displays 'Thank you for your order!'
requirements.expectedOutcome: Checkout completes with mathematically correct price breakdown and a success confirmation message

requirements.title: checkout form shows error when submitted with empty fields
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
One item is in the cart
The user is on checkout step one at /checkout-step-one.html
acceptanceCriteria: Given checkout step one is displayed with all fields empty
When the user clicks the Continue button without filling any fields
Then an error message is visible on the page
requirements.expectedOutcome: Checkout form blocks progression and displays a validation error when submitted empty

requirements.title: cancelling from checkout step one returns to cart with items intact
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
Two items are in the cart
The user is on checkout step one at /checkout-step-one.html
acceptanceCriteria: Given checkout step one is displayed with 2 items in the cart
When the user clicks the Cancel button
Then the browser navigates back to /cart.html
And the cart still shows 2 items
requirements.expectedOutcome: Cancelling checkout returns the user to their cart without losing any added items

requirements.title: order summary on step two lists the correct item names
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
Two items are in the cart
Shipping information has been filled and the user is on checkout step two
acceptanceCriteria: Given checkout step two (order review) is displayed
When the page loads
Then the item names listed in the order summary match the names of the products added to the cart
requirements.expectedOutcome: Order review accurately reflects all items added to the cart before checkout

requirements.title: cancelling from checkout step two returns to inventory
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
One item is in the cart
The user is on checkout step two at /checkout-step-two.html
acceptanceCriteria: Given checkout step two is displayed
When the user clicks the Cancel button
Then the browser navigates to /inventory.html
And the page heading displays 'Products'
requirements.expectedOutcome: Cancelling from the order review page returns the user to the main inventory

requirements.title: locked-out user sees a specific account-locked error
preconditions: No active session exists (storageState is clean for this test)
The SauceDemo login page is accessible at /
The locked_out_user credentials are available via CI secret / .env
acceptanceCriteria: Given the login page is displayed
When the locked_out_user submits their credentials
Then an error message containing 'Sorry, this user has been locked out.' is displayed
requirements.expectedOutcome: Login is blocked with a clear account-locked error message for the locked_out_user account

requirements.title: submitting the login form with no username shows a validation error
preconditions: No active session exists (storageState is clean for this test)
The SauceDemo login page is accessible at /
acceptanceCriteria: Given the login page is displayed with both fields empty
When the user clicks the Login button without entering any credentials
Then an error message containing 'Username is required' is displayed
requirements.expectedOutcome: Login form blocks submission and surfaces a username validation error when no credentials are provided

requirements.title: submitting the login form with no password shows a validation error
preconditions: No active session exists (storageState is clean for this test)
The SauceDemo login page is accessible at /
A valid username is available
acceptanceCriteria: Given the login page is displayed
When the user enters a valid username but leaves the password field empty and clicks Login
Then an error message containing 'Password is required' is displayed
requirements.expectedOutcome: Login form blocks submission and surfaces a password validation error when password is omitted

requirements.title: wrong credentials show a credential-mismatch error
preconditions: No active session exists (storageState is clean for this test)
The SauceDemo login page is accessible at /
acceptanceCriteria: Given the login page is displayed
When the user enters a valid username with an incorrect password and clicks Login
Then an error message containing 'Username and password do not match any user in this service' is displayed
requirements.expectedOutcome: Login is rejected with a credential-mismatch error when the password is wrong

requirements.title: clicking a product on inventory navigates to its detail page with matching name and price
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
The inventory page is loaded with all 6 products visible
acceptanceCriteria: Given the inventory page is displayed
When the user clicks on the first product
Then the browser navigates to the product detail page
And the detail page displays the same product name as shown on the inventory
And the detail page displays the same price as shown on the inventory
requirements.expectedOutcome: Product detail page loads with name and price that exactly match the inventory listing

requirements.title: adding a product to cart from the detail page increments the cart badge
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
The user is on a product detail page
The cart is empty
acceptanceCriteria: Given a product detail page is displayed with an empty cart
When the user clicks 'Add to cart'
Then the cart count increments to 1
requirements.expectedOutcome: Cart badge reflects the item added from the product detail page

requirements.title: back button on the detail page returns the user to the inventory listing
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
The user is on a product detail page
acceptanceCriteria: Given a product detail page is displayed
When the user clicks the Back button
Then the browser navigates back to /inventory.html
requirements.expectedOutcome: User is returned to the full inventory listing after pressing Back on a product detail page

requirements.title: All Items link in the burger menu navigates to the inventory page
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
The inventory page is loaded and the burger menu is accessible
acceptanceCriteria: Given the inventory page is displayed
When the user opens the burger menu and clicks 'All Items'
Then the browser URL matches /inventory.html
And the page heading displays 'Products'
requirements.expectedOutcome: Clicking All Items in the burger menu lands the user on the inventory page

requirements.title: Logout link in the burger menu ends the session and redirects to the login page
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
The inventory page is loaded and the burger menu is accessible
acceptanceCriteria: Given the inventory page is displayed with an active session
When the user opens the burger menu and clicks 'Logout'
Then the session is terminated
And the login page is displayed with the username input and login button visible
requirements.expectedOutcome: User is logged out and redirected to the login page with no active session remaining

requirements.title: Reset App State in the burger menu clears all items from the cart
preconditions: An active authenticated session exists via storageState
Two items have been added to the cart
The cart badge is visible showing '2'
acceptanceCriteria: Given the inventory page is displayed with 2 items in the cart
When the user opens the burger menu and clicks 'Reset App State'
Then the cart badge is no longer visible
And the cart is empty
requirements.expectedOutcome: All cart state is cleared and the badge disappears after resetting app state via the burger menu
